name: triage-ticket
description: Parses an incoming support ticket, runs parallel sentiment/category/priority analysis, then drafts a customer-appropriate response with routing recommendation

agents.name: ticket-intake
agents.prompt: Parse the incoming support ticket into structured data

agents.name: sentiment-analyzer
agents.prompt: Analyze the customer's emotional tone and urgency

agents.name: category-classifier
agents.prompt: Classify the ticket topic and determine routing

agents.name: priority-scorer
agents.prompt: Score ticket priority based on all available signals

agents.name: response-drafter
agents.prompt: Draft a response combining all analysis into an appropriate customer reply
